description: Base rates for brand-new tokens on a chain, measured by GL1TCH from tokens sampled at birth: share that stopped trading within an hour, share down ≥50% / ≥90% three days later, median change. Use as context before buying a token younger than three days. Not a prediction for any single token.

chain.description: solana, ethereum, base, bsc, arbitrum or polygon

name: new_token_reality
title: New Token Reality: what happens to brand-new tokens in 3 days
